cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(OriginalMotionPipeline LANGUAGES CXX)
option(MOTION_PIPELINE_ASAN "Check original motion pipeline with AddressSanitizer" OFF)
enable_testing()
foreach(component physical_refinement rig_application motion_chain)
    add_executable(${component}_checks ${component}_checks.cpp)
    target_compile_features(${component}_checks PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
    set_target_properties(${component}_checks PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${component}_checks PRIVATE /utf-8 /W4 /WX)
        if(MOTION_PIPELINE_ASAN)
            target_compile_options(${component}_checks PRIVATE /fsanitize=address /Zi)
            target_link_options(${component}_checks PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO /DEBUG)
        endif()
    else()
        target_compile_options(${component}_checks PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME ${component}_checks COMMAND ${component}_checks)
endforeach()
